from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode, V_INIT_MV
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial
import numpy as np, time
artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
from neuron import h
soma = artifacts.cell.soma
ais = artifacts.cell.axon_initial_segment
# Try: increase gl_hh on AIS to make leak dominate, with el_hh = -65
ais.gl_hh = 0.005
ais.el_hh = -65.0

v_rec = h.Vector(); v_rec.record(soma(0.5)._ref_v)
h.finitialize(V_INIT_MV)
h.continuerun(200.0)
v = np.array(list(v_rec))
print(f'V_rest with ais.gl_hh=0.005, el_hh=-65: {v[-1]:.3f}')

for (mode, angle) in [(TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 0), (TrialMode.FULL, 0), (TrialMode.FULL, 60), (TrialMode.FULL, 90), (TrialMode.FULL, 120), (TrialMode.FULL, 180)]:
    t0 = time.time()
    res = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=mode, angle_deg=float(angle), trial_seed=1)
    print(f'{mode.value} {angle}: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')
